alerts.detail:

alerts.heading: Wilding conifer control operation for Motueka Gorge and Red Hills
alerts.detail:
There will be a helicopter spot-spraying herbicide onto wilding conifers on the hills surrounding the Motueka Gorge and Hunter's Hut over several fine weather days, from 4 August to 25 October 2026.

The herbicide ingredients are triclopyr and biodiesel. The target wilding conifer species are individual plants of Douglas fir and contorta pine.

See the operation maps (PDF, 320K) for the locations of the spraying (shaded blue), and do not enter these area

alerts.heading: Kowhai and Hapuku Huts temporary closures for repair work
alerts.detail:
From 14–17 September 2026 both the Kowhai and Hapuku Huts will be closed for overnight stays while staff undertake post flood repair work.

There is room to camp outside Kowhai Hut if needed, but not at Hapuku Hut.

First published on 26 August 2026.

alerts.heading: Limited access to Mt Fyffe car park due to weather damage
alerts.detail:
Due to recent weather events, a 4WD vehicle is essential to access the Mt Fyffe bottom car park. We do not recommend crossing the ford during heavy rain due to a build-up of gravel.

The Hinau Track is open but due to weather damage, sturdy footwear is recommended.

First published on 9 July 2026. Last reviewed on 9 July 2026.
